title: Negima! Magister Negi Magi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ten-year-old mage Negi Springfield becomes the English teacher of an all-girl middle school class at Mahora Academy while hiding his magic and searching for his missing father. He forms magical Pactio contracts, sealed by kisses, with students who become his fighting partners against the vampire Evangeline, Eastern mages and threats in the Magic World. A long-running Ken Akamatsu series that moves from harem comedy to large-scale fantasy battles.
life_message: Growing up means taking responsibility for others, forging bonds of trust and fighting to protect them.
